name: IIS - HTTP Error
description: The IIS - HTTP Error Dashboard provides detailed information on IIS error logging in HTTP. Dashboard panels show details on error events, top client and server IP addresses, top protocol versions and protocol status. Panels also show information on top reason phrases and verbs associated with HTTP errors, as well as top request details by reason.
title: IIS - HTTP Error

panels.title: Understanding HTTPERR and Reason Phrase
panels.text:
HTTPERR logs:

The request may be rejected by HTTP.SYS before it even made it to an IIS worker process. In such cases the error is logged in the HTTPERR logs.

Understanding Reason Phrase: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/820729/error-logging-in-http-apis
